scope: local synthetic fixtures only; no publication, cloud deployment or external receiver

covers: tenant API and restricted worker RLS and negative privileges
concurrent claims, lease recovery, stale completion fencing
key generation persistence/rotation, wrong master key fails before dispatch, restored key replay
seven attempt budget, three replay bound, revocation and expiry
six unit cases including signed loopback HTTP wire/status/redirect tests
all seven actual API/MCP/CLI operations and one event/one cent for eight retries
worker process rejects API database identity
worker-only DB and webhook key secrets, empty AWS task role
callback subnet NAT routes, DNS and stateless return rules, private-destination ACL denies
worker desired count and three alarms

limitations: Loopback HTTP wire verification is not hosted HTTPS receiver evidence.
Network and alarm configuration is synthesized, not deployed or exercised in AWS.
Local logical dump timings are not RDS PITR, production RTO/RPO or callback capacity measurements.
Endpoint signing-key generations persist; transparent master-key ring rotation is not implemented.
